expressions.INPUT1: CASE    WHEN ailh_store_sales_bronze_v.SALE_TIMESTAMP IS NULL      OR TRIM(ailh_store_sales_bronze_v.SALE_TIMESTAMP)          IN ('', 'null', 'N/A')    THEN NULL    ELSE TO_TIMESTAMP(        '2025-01-01 00:' ||        TRIM(ailh_store_sales_bronze_v.SALE_TIMESTAMP),        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF'    )END

CASE    WHEN ailh_products_bronze_v.CATEGORY IS NULL      OR TRIM(ailh_products_bronze_v.CATEGORY) = ''      OR LOWER(TRIM(ailh_products_bronze_v.CATEGORY))          IN ('n/a', 'na', 'null')    THEN 'Unknown'    ELSE INITCAP(        TRIM(            REGEXP_REPLACE(                ailh_products_bronze_v.CATEGORY,                '[[:space:]]',                ' '            )        )    )END

TRUNC(     CAST(         CASE             WHEN ailh_store_sales_bronze_v.SALE_TIMESTAMP IS NULL             THEN NULL             ELSE TO_TIMESTAMP(                 '2025-01-01 00:' ||                 TRIM(ailh_store_sales_bronze_v.SALE_TIMESTAMP),                 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF'             )         END         AS DATE     ),     'MM' )

CASE     WHEN ailh_store_locations_bronze_v.LOCATION IS NULL     THEN 'Unknown'     ELSE INITCAP(         TRIM(             REGEXP_SUBSTR(                 ailh_store_locations_bronze_v.LOCATION,                 '[^,]+',                 1,                 2             )         )     ) END

CASE     WHEN ailh_store_locations_bronze_v.LOCATION IS NULL     THEN 'Unknown'     ELSE UPPER(         SUBSTR(             TRIM(                 REGEXP_SUBSTR(                     ailh_store_locations_bronze_v.LOCATION,                     '[^,]+',                     1,                     3                 )             ),             1,             2         )     ) END

CASE     WHEN ailh_store_locations_bronze_v.LOCATION IS NULL       OR LOWER(             TRIM(ailh_store_locations_bronze_v.LOCATION)           ) IN ('null', 'n/a', 'na')     THEN 'Unknown'      WHEN UPPER(             SUBSTR(                 TRIM(                     REGEXP_SUBSTR(                         ailh_store_locations_bronze_v.LOCATION,                         '[^,]+',                         1,                         3                     )                 ),                 1,                 2             )           ) IN (             'AK','AZ','CA','CO','HI','ID','MT',             'NV','NM','OR','UT','WA','WY'           )     THEN 'West'      ELSE 'Other' END

CASE    WHEN ailh_store_sales_bronze_v.QTY_SOLD IS NULL      OR ailh_products_bronze_v.COST_PRICE IS NULL    THEN NULL    ELSE        ailh_store_sales_bronze_v.QTY_SOLD        * ailh_products_bronze_v.COST_PRICE END

CASE    WHEN ailh_store_sales_bronze_v.TOTAL_SALE_AMOUNT IS NULL      OR ailh_store_sales_bronze_v.QTY_SOLD IS NULL      OR ailh_products_bronze_v.COST_PRICE IS NULL    THEN NULL    ELSE        ailh_store_sales_bronze_v.TOTAL_SALE_AMOUNT        - (            ailh_store_sales_bronze_v.QTY_SOLD            * ailh_products_bronze_v.COST_PRICE          )END

CASE    WHEN ailh_store_sales_bronze_v.TOTAL_SALE_AMOUNT IS NULL      OR ailh_store_sales_bronze_v.TOTAL_SALE_AMOUNT = 0      OR ailh_store_sales_bronze_v.QTY_SOLD IS NULL      OR ailh_products_bronze_v.COST_PRICE IS NULL    THEN NULL    ELSE        (            (                ailh_store_sales_bronze_v.TOTAL_SALE_AMOUNT                - (                    ailh_store_sales_bronze_v.QTY_SOLD                    * ailh_products_bronze_v.COST_PRICE                  )            )            / ailh_store_sales_bronze_v.TOTAL_SALE_AMOUNT        ) * 100 END

sqlSteps.name: Clear Silver table
Create Silver View
sqlSteps.sqlText:
BEGIN
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE q'[
        CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW PG."ailh_enriched_sales_v" AS
        SELECT
            "SALE_MONTH",
            "PRODUCT_ID",
            "PRODUCT_NAME",
            "CATEGORY",
            "STATE",
            "CHANNEL_TYPE",
            "SALES_REGION",
            "QTY_SOLD",
            "TOTAL_SALE_AMOUNT",
            "ESTIMATED_COST",
            "ESTIMATED_GROSS_MARGIN",
            "TXN_ID",
            "ESTIMATED_MARGIN_PCT"
        FROM "silver"."AILH_ENRICHED_SALES"@"PG_AICAT"
    ]';
END;

sqlSteps.name: Create Bronze Views
sqlSteps.sqlText:
BEGIN
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE q'[
        CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW PG."ailh_products_bronze_v" AS
        SELECT
            "PRODUCT_ID",
            "PRODUCT_NAME",
            "CATEGORY",
            "COST_PRICE",
            "RETAIL_PRICE",
            "SKU"
        FROM "bronze"."products"@"PG_AICAT"
    ]';

    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE q'[
        CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW PG."ailh_store_locations_bronze_v" AS
        SELECT
            "STORE_ID",
            "LOCATION",
            "MANAGER",
            "OPENED_DATE",
            "CHANNEL_TYPE",
            "STORE_TYPE"
        FROM "bronze"."store_locations"@"PG_AICAT"
    ]';

    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE q'[
        CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW PG."ailh_store_sales_bronze_v" AS
        SELECT
            "TXN_ID",
            "SALE_TIMESTAMP",
            "STORE_ID",
            "PRODUCT_ID",
            "QTY_SOLD",
            "TOTAL_SALE_AMOUNT"
        FROM "bronze"."store_sales_transactions"@"PG_AICAT"
    ]';

    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE q'[
        CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW PG."ailh_store_inventory_bronze_v" AS
        SELECT
            "STORE_ID",
            "PRODUCT_ID",
            "STOCK_ON_HAND",
            "LAST_STOCK_UPDATE",
            "REORDER_LEVEL",
            "AVAILABLE_TO_PROMISE_QTY",
            "INVENTORY_STATUS"
        FROM "bronze"."store_inventory"@"PG_AICAT"
    ]';
END;
